basic_details.job_title: ECHS Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 11 Medical and Non-Medical Staff Posts
basic_details.short_information: Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) has released the official Various Medical and Non-Medical Staff Notification 2026 on the official website, https://www.echs.gov.in. A total of 11 vacancies have been announced under the ECHS Recruitment 2026. Candidates possessing qualifications such as Literate, 8th Class, Class 1 MT Driver, Diploma in Dental Hygiene, B.Pharmacy, GNM Diploma, BDS, or Graduate are eligible to apply. The application process is being conducted in offline mode, with the last date to submit applications being 20 August 2026, and the walkin interview is scheduled for

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate, BDS, GNM Diploma, B Pharmacy, Diploma in Dental Hygiene, 8th Class/Class 1 MT Driver, Literate.
qualification.details: Officer in charge (Panaji): Graduate, Minimum 5 Years work experience in health care institutions or Managerial positions. Dental Offr (Panaji): BDS, Minimum 03 years work experience. Dental Offr (Sindhudurg): BDS, Minimum 03 years work experience. Nur Asst (Sindhudurg): GNM Diploma / Class I Nursing assistant course (Armed Forces), minimum 05 years work experience. Pharmacist (Panaji): B Pharmacy from a recognized institute or 10/12 with science from a recognized board & Approved diploma in Pharmacy from an institute recognized by the Pharmacy Council of India and registered as pharmacist under the Pharmacy Act 1948, Minimum 3 years work experience. Dental A/T/H (Panaji): Diploma holder in Dental Hyg/Class-1 DH/DORA course (Armed Forces), Minimum 05 years work experience. Amb Driver (Panaji): 8th class / Class 1 MT Driver (Armed Forces) Possess a civil driving licence, minimum 05 Years work experience. Female Attendant (Panaji): Literate, minimum 05 Years work experience. Female Attendant (Sindhudurg): Literate, minimum 05 Years work experience. Safaiwala (Panaji): Literate, minimum 05 Years work experience. Safaiwala (Sindhudurg): Literate, minimum 05 Years work experience.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the ECHS recruitment is 20th August 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies for various Medical and Non-Medical Staff posts in the Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the ECHS posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification varies depending on the post. It ranges from 8th Class to Graduate, BDS, GNM Diploma, and B Pharmacy. Please refer to the detailed eligibility criteria for specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The salary for the ECHS posts ranges from Rs. 21,800/- to Rs. 95,000/- per month, depending on the post and the candidate's qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this ECHS recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates will be conducted on 27th August 2026. Candidates are advised to be prepared for the interview on the specified date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the official website of ECHS?
faq.answer: The official website of the Ex Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) is www.echs.gov.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and to download the application form.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any specific experience requirements for the posts?
faq.answer: Yes, most of the posts require a minimum work experience ranging from 3 to 5 years in relevant fields. The specific experience required for each post is detailed in the eligibility criteria section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for ECHS recruitment typically involves an interview followed by On Job Training (OJT) for the selected candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the application form?
faq.answer: The application form, along with self-attested photocopies of testimonials, should be submitted to Stn HQs ECHS Cell Panaji by the last date mentioned in the notification.
